simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נִאֻף (H5004) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נִאֻף (niʼuph) means adultery First listed occurrence: Ezek 23 43.

definitions.full: H5004. niuph [ נִאֻף ] noun [masculine] adultery ; — only plural נִאֻפִים Ezek 23:43 (but ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Co נִאֲפוּ , compare Berthol); suffix נִאֻפַ֫יִךְ Jer 13:27 (Kö i. 151 ); figurative of idolatrous worship.
